Ask anything if you have questions about the game as well.

[*]Increasing reputation with a faction will decrease the reputation of their enemy towards you, and visa-versa.
[*]You can create road from 'Tamp' action on the ground.
[*]Chests and Barrels in underground are refilled periodically.
[*]Merchants no longer sell legendary trinkets with random chances. You have to find them inside the legendary chests in the dungeons.

[*]Fixed a bug selling an item that NPC buys at premium while NPC is your ally messed up reputation score.
[*]Fixed a bug where NPCs that are asleep can detect your crime and misdemeanor.

[*]Fixed a bug respawning a character with max hp 1 didn't revive you.

[*]Fixed a bug wearing Magic Eye enchant threw error from revealing fog of war.

[*]Fixed a bug Life Steal applied twice the amount.
[*]Fixed carnivores and herbivores could eat dishes they aren't supposed to. You can look at which food item is edible by a carnivore or a herbivore from in-game Encyclopedia.

[*]Buffed base speed and hp increased from leveling up, from 0.03/15 to 0.05/20

[*]Nerfed the amount and chance of gem of powers loot from monsters.

[*]Nerfed the price NPCs buy at premium, from twice of the price to normal(it's still double the price you get for selling elsewhere)

[*]Nerfed Party Perks "Increased Defence" and "Speed Boost" by half.

notes.title: Patch 0.7.1 is here!
notes.content:
[h2]#SYSTEM[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Deposit Area has been added to the game. If you leave materials in these tiles, your characters in automatic mode will pick up the items from nearby deposit areas to build. It’s now easier to manage multiple characters.  
(Auto-dropping items onto the deposit area when bags are full is still in development.)  
[*] You can now create up to 4 characters in character creation again.  
[/list]

[h2]#GAMEPLAY[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Added items 'Well' and 'Powder Keg' to the game. You can build them from the Construction Window. Be careful — Powder Kegs can be so deadly that they won’t even leave corpses you can loot!  
[*] Flame now spreads to neighboring tiles.  
[*] Saplings will drop when you cut down a tree. If left on the ground, they will grow into a tree in about 10 days unless the outside temperature is below zero.  
[*] You can now throw items. Flying objects can hit targets and deal damage. Throwing distance is based on a dice roll from your Ranged skill level.  
[*] Dead animal and monster corpses decay over time.  
[*] Melee monsters no longer stack on top of each other when moving into combat range.  
[*] Cooking recipes now require slightly higher cooking skills — on average +4 more. Cooking near a Stove gives a +6 cooking skill bonus.  
[*] You can right-click to move in RPG mode.  
[*] Event popups no longer force-pause the game.  
[*] You can set fire to gunpowder with a lit torch in hand. More gunpowder = stronger fire.  
[*] You can jump over cliffs instead of using a ladder. Failed jump rolls may result in fractures and bleeding.  
[*] Holding a waterskin in hand while extinguishing fire greatly improves efficiency — from 1 tile to 8 nearby tiles.  
[*] You can drain water from a waterskin placed on the ground to create a puddle. Be careful: if volume exceeds 100, it triggers waterflow physics and can damage nearby.  
[*] Flame strength is now capped at 250 to prevent world-scale fire accidents that could brick save files.  
[*] HP recovery from perks, items, rest, sleep — and damage from debuffs — now show colored visual effects.  
[*] Frozen rivers, lakes, and oceans will thaw quickly in early spring.  
[/list]

[h2]#BALANCE[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Berserk extra damage buffed from 2,4,6,8,10 to 4,8,12,16,20.  
[/list]

[h2]#BUGFIX - GAMEPLAY[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Fixed first auto-attack in combat sometimes not working.  
[*] Fixed perks requiring items to learn causing errors.  
[*] Fixed being unable to eat/drink items held in hand.  
[*] Fixed enchants from trinkets not applying correctly.  
[*] Fixed manually force-closing automatic doors leaving them permanently open.  
[*] Fixed missing actions on sand cliffs.  
[*] Fixed Berserk perk not granting extra damage.  
[*] Fixed shrine cooldown back to 1 day (20 minutes).  
[*] Fixed Perk [Grave's Grace] causing error during respawn.  
[*] Fixed flame not extinguishing when reaching narrow water tiles.  
[*] Fixed not getting wet from shallow, narrow water.  
[*] Fixed other factions' tombstones using "Pick up" instead of "Steal".  
[*] Fixed energy recovering indefinitely when sprint toggle is on.  
[*] Fixed strange shapes forming during water freeze/thaw.  
[*] Fixed blacksmiths charging less gold than intended for equipment repairs.  
[/list]

notes.content:

[h1]Ver 0.7.0 has been updated[/h1]

[h2]#SYSTEM & IMPORTANT[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] [b]As previously noticed, You can no longer play with your older save files from 0.6.x versions. This was a necessary decision for so much of Game Sysem and UI have changed with this update. However from hereon, I will try to keep savefiles compatible forever until and after Ver 1.0 release.[/b]
[*] Traits and Abilities are now part of the new PERK system.  Make a new character and go to Character Sheet to look at the new PERK tab. Now you can have a limitless combination of character progression with the Perk system which allows you to pick whatever perks you want, as long as you met one of the Multi-Prerequisite system Cross The World's Perk system brings to you.
[*] New character creation UI has been updated to fit the PERK system. You no longer randomly roll skill levels until you get what you want, instead you can +- skill levels with your creation points as well as base skill levels being derived from what Race, Class you chose to play with.
[*] UI and Controls have changed completely that you now use your mouse Scrolls to switch between actions available on your target. Previous zoom in/out function has been remapped to "Left Shift + Mouse Scrolls"
[/list]

[h2]#ENVIRONMENT[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Implemented new spawn/generation algorithm to the game.  
[*] Items spawn more often, and each wild item has its own season when it spawns. Previously, items would only re-generate once a year, but now the generation algorithm runs every 7 days (per season).  
[*] Animals and monsters respawn throughout the spring, summer, and autumn.  
[/list]

[h2]#GAMEPLAY[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] You can only start as a single member and recruit/create more as you progress (this isn't a permanent change, but more of an experiment — feedback is welcome).  
[*] Tombstone can be picked up.  
[*] Unconscious animals and monsters heal slowly over time.  
[*] You can only teleport between shrines of the same color.  
[*] Mountains in northern Arid Lands are now made of stone instead of soil.  
[*] Player automatically enters combat when attacked by an enemy.  
[*] Magic skill level reduces incoming magic damage.  
[*] Divine skill level reduces incoming corrupted and haunted damage.  
[/list]

[h2]#BALANCE[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] More stones drop from breaking rocks.  
[*] Lighting objects held in hand lose less durability — 15% of the previous rate.  
[*] Nerfed Party Perk <HP BOOST> from 25 to 20, <ENERGY BOOST> from 12 to 6, <BETTER ATTACK> from 10 to 7, <CRITICAL CHANCE> from 5 to 3.  
[*] There's a minimum 3% chance for an attack to land, regardless of how high dodge chance is.  
[*] Blacksmith and Miner NPCs no longer sell corrupted ingots and ores.  
[/list]

[h2]#SETTING & CONTROL[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Removed "Manual Mode" from controls as it is obsolete.  
[*] Mouse wheel to zoom in/out now requires holding Left Shift.  
[*] When in RPG Mode, you can now right-click on a visible tile (not hidden by fog of war) to move.  
[/list]

[h2]#QOL[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Shift + Right click on item, animal, or monster on screen to open in-game encyclopedia.  
[*] All shrine locations now show on the map.  
[*] Tamed animals and monsters' health bars show when not at 100%.  
[/list]

[h2]#BUGFIX - GAMEPLAY[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Fixed materials consuming double the amount when present in both crafting slot and inventory.  
[*] Fixed being unable to pick up seeds off the ground.  
[*] Fixed 2x/3x game speed burning fuel faster when torch is in hand.  
[*] Fixed tamed animal/monster getting stuck at new home.  
[*] Fixed tamed animal/monster not attacking their own kin.  
[*] Fixed typos in materials for Critical-Damage Potion and Immunity Potion.  
[*] Fixed typo where forging Iron Bow created Iron Hammer.  
[*] Fixed items instantly rotting or degrading upon loot.  
[/list]

[h2]#MULTIPLAYER[/h2]

[/list]
